title: Apple Inc.
text: Apple designs and sells smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and services. Its product lineup includes the iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch, and its services include cloud storage, streaming and the App Store.

title: Microsoft Corporation
text: Microsoft develops enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, productivity applications and personal computing devices. Its products include Windows, Office, Azure cloud services and Xbox gaming.

title: NVIDIA Corporation
text: NVIDIA designs graphics processing units and accelerated computing platforms for gaming, data centers and artificial intelligence. Its chips power AI training, inference and visualization workloads.

title: Amazon.com Inc.
text: Amazon operates an online retail marketplace and cloud infrastructure business. Amazon Web Services provides cloud computing, storage and database services, while the retail segment sells consumer goods and operates logistics.

title: Alphabet Inc.
text: Alphabet's Google provides search, digital advertising, cloud computing, video streaming and mobile operating systems. Its businesses include Google Search, YouTube, Android and Google Cloud.

title: Meta Platforms Inc.
text: Meta Platforms operates social media applications and advertising businesses. Its products include Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and virtual reality hardware, with revenue driven mainly by digital advertising.

title: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
text: JPMorgan Chase provides consumer banking, investment banking, credit cards, mortgage lending and asset management services. It is a global financial institution serving individuals and corporations.

title: Johnson & Johnson
text: Johnson & Johnson develops pharmaceuticals, medical devices and consumer health products. Its portfolio includes prescription medicines, surgical devices and over-the-counter consumer brands.

title: Exxon Mobil Corporation
text: Exxon Mobil explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas, and operates refining and chemicals businesses. It also invests in low-carbon energy and fuels.

title: Procter & Gamble
text: Procter & Gamble sells household and personal care products. Its brands include detergents, shampoo, diapers, paper products and oral care.

title: The Coca-Cola Company
text: The Coca-Cola Company produces and sells carbonated soft drinks, bottled water, juice and other beverages. Its brand portfolio includes Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta and Dasani.

title: Walmart Inc.
text: Walmart operates supercenters, discount stores, warehouse clubs and grocery retail businesses. It sells consumer goods, groceries and household products through stores and e-commerce.
